words.definitionEn: The activity of going from one place to another; also a verb meaning to go between places.
words.example: Travel can broaden your outlook.

words.definitionEn: An occasion of travelling from one place to another.
words.translationUz: bir joydan boshqa joyga safar, yo‘l
words.example: We had a long journey by coach.

words.definitionEn: A visit away from home, often including the return journey; a work-related visit.
words.example: She went on a business trip to Berlin.

words.term: go on a trip / take a trip
words.definitionEn: To travel somewhere for a visit.
words.example: We plan to go on a trip to the coast.

words.term: a voyage / a voyage of discovery
words.definitionEn: A long journey, especially by sea; figuratively, a process of discovering new things.
words.translationUz: uzoq dengiz safari / yangi narsalarni kashf etish jarayoni
words.example: Learning about another culture can be a voyage of discovery.

words.definitionEn: A regular flight operating according to a published timetable.
words.example: We booked a scheduled flight to Madrid.

words.definitionEn: A flight hired for a particular group or purpose rather than a regular scheduled service.
words.translationUz: charter reys, maxsus buyurtma qilingan reys
words.example: The tour operator arranged a charter flight.
words.collocations: charter a flight, charter an aircraft

words.definitionEn: An airline offering relatively inexpensive fares, often charging separately for extras.
words.example: The budget airline charges extra for checked luggage.

words.definitionEn: An airline strongly associated with a particular country.
words.example: The national carrier operates international routes.

words.definitionEn: Different categories of travel service, comfort and fare.
words.translationUz: birinchi toifa / biznes toifa / ekonom toifa
words.example: We travelled in economy class.
words.collocations: fly first class, fly business class, fly economy

words.definitionEn: A travel path passing through a particular place.
words.example: We chose a route via Amsterdam to reach Oslo.

words.definitionEn: A booking covering air travel without accommodation or a holiday package.
words.translationUz: faqat aviachipta, turar joysiz parvoz bandlovi
words.example: We chose flight only and booked our own hotel.

words.definitionEn: A holiday combining travel and accommodation, with other services depending on the package.
words.translationUz: yo‘l va turar joyni o‘z ichiga olgan dam olish paketi
words.example: A package holiday can simplify planning.

words.definitionEn: A holiday with specified accommodation, meals, drinks and other services included in its price.
words.translationUz: belgilangan xizmatlar narxga kiritilgan dam olish paketi
words.example: We checked which activities our all-inclusive holiday covered.

words.definitionEn: Additional services or charges beyond the basic booking.
words.translationUz: safarga oid qo‘shimcha xizmatlar yoki to‘lovlar
words.example: Travel extras increased the final price.

words.definitionEn: Rules or conditions limiting where, when or how people may travel or use a ticket.
words.example: Read the travel restrictions before buying.
words.collocations: travel restriction, impose a travel restriction, lift a travel restriction

words.definitionEn: Describing a payment or ticket for which money is not normally returned after cancellation.
words.example: The cheapest ticket was non-refundable.

words.definitionEn: Money charged for cancelling a booking.
words.example: We had to pay a cancellation fee.

words.definitionEn: Worth the price paid because of the quality or amount provided.
words.example: The rail pass was good value for money.

words.definitionEn: A planned stop during a longer journey before continuing to the destination.
words.example: We included a stopover in Singapore.

words.definitionEn: Transport between places such as an airport and hotel.
words.translationUz: transfer, masalan, aeroportdan mehmonxonaga olib borish xizmati
words.example: The hotel booking included an airport transfer.

words.definitionEn: A bus making regular short journeys between particular places.
words.translationUz: belgilangan ikki joy orasida muntazam qatnaydigan avtobus
words.example: A shuttle bus connects the terminal and hotel.

words.definitionEn: The temporary use of a car in exchange for payment.
words.example: Car hire gave us greater flexibility.

words.definitionEn: A hire arrangement with no distance-based limit or additional mileage charge.
words.translationUz: bosib o‘tiladigan masofaga cheklov qo‘yilmagan ijara sharti
words.example: The rental price includes unlimited mileage.

words.definitionEn: Insurance covering specified losses or costs associated with an accident.
words.example: We checked what the accident insurance covered.

words.definitionEn: To travel between places in an area.
words.translationUz: bir hudud ichida u yerdan bu yerga qatnamoq
words.example: It is easy to get around by tram.

words.term: come and go as you please
words.definitionEn: To arrive and leave whenever you choose.
words.example: The guest house gives you a key so you can come and go as you please.

words.definitionEn: Travelling for work or business purposes.
words.translationUz: ish yuzasidan sayohat qilish, xizmat safarlariga chiqish
words.example: Business travel is becoming more common in our company.
words.collocations: reduce business travel, business travel expenses

words.definitionEn: Be moved to a business-class seat, often without paying the full extra fare.
words.example: On an overbooked flight, you may be upgraded to business class.
words.collocations: get bumped up to business class (informal)

words.definitionEn: A flight, train or other service that you change to during a journey.
words.translationUz: safar davomida o‘tiladigan keyingi reys yoki qatnov
words.example: We had a tight connection in Istanbul.
words.collocations: catch a connection, miss a connection, connecting flight

words.definitionEn: A wait at an airport or another transport hub between connecting services.
words.translationUz: keyingi reysni yoki qatnovni kutish uchun oraliq to‘xtash
words.example: We had a three-hour layover in Istanbul.

words.definitionEn: Passage through a place on the way to another destination.
words.translationUz: tranzit, manzilga borish yo‘lida oraliq hududdan o‘tish
words.example: Our bags stayed in transit until we reached Tashkent.
words.collocations: in transit, transit passenger, transit visa

words.definitionEn: A service in which someone meets you at the airport and takes you to your destination.
words.translationUz: aeroportdan kutib olish va olib ketish xizmati
words.example: The hotel offers a free airport pick-up.

words.definitionEn: A hotel or holiday package with more services or extras included than its standard all-inclusive option.
words.translationUz: odatdagi all-inclusive paketiga qaraganda ko‘proq xizmatlar narxga kiritilgan paket
words.example: The ultra all-inclusive package included access to a wider choice of restaurants.

words.definitionEn: Officially introduce a rule that limits travel.
words.example: The authorities may impose a travel restriction after a severe storm.

words.definitionEn: Officially remove a rule that limits travel.
words.example: The authorities can lift a travel restriction once the roads are safe.

words.definitionEn: Pay to use a car for a limited period.
words.example: We plan to hire a car for a week to visit the villages.
words.collocations: rent a car, hire a car for a day

words.definitionEn: A journey by road, often for pleasure and with stops along the way.
words.example: We took a road trip along the coast last summer.

words.definitionEn: A journey across much of a country.
words.example: They took a cross-country trip by train.

words.definitionEn: A plan of a trip showing the places, dates or activities arranged.
words.translationUz: sayohat rejasi, safar yo‘nalishi va jadvali
words.example: Our itinerary included two days in Bukhara.

words.definitionEn: A long-distance bus; also a passenger carriage on a train.
words.example: We travelled overnight by coach.

words.definitionEn: A passenger vehicle running on rails along streets.
words.example: A tram stops outside the station.

words.definitionEn: A road vehicle for carrying goods; a lorry is a large goods vehicle.
words.example: A lorry delivered supplies to the hotel.

words.definitionEn: A car’s luggage compartment / the wheel used to control its direction.
words.example: Put the bags in the boot before taking the steering wheel.

words.definitionEn: A person driving a car.
words.example: A motorist stopped to help us change the tyre.

words.definitionEn: A person who repairs machines, especially vehicle engines.
words.example: A mechanic inspected the engine.

words.definitionEn: A driver employed to drive someone, usually in a private car.
words.example: A chauffeur collected the guests.

words.definitionEn: A place where drivers buy fuel.
words.example: We stopped at a petrol station.

words.definitionEn: To stop working, especially of a vehicle; a service that helps stranded motorists.
words.translationUz: buzilib qolmoq / yo‘lda buzilgan transportga yordam xizmati
words.example: If we break down, we can call a breakdown service.

words.definitionEn: A train designed for high speeds / a service with relatively few stops.
words.translationUz: tezyurar poyezd / kam bekatda to‘xtaydigan ekspress poyezd
words.example: The express train stops only at major stations.

words.definitionEn: A railway carriage with beds for overnight travel.
words.example: We booked beds in a sleeping car.

words.definitionEn: A railway carriage selling food and drinks.
words.example: We bought sandwiches in the buffet car.

words.definitionEn: A railway worker who checks tickets; a conductor may have wider onboard duties.
words.example: The conductor checked our tickets.

words.definitionEn: The area beside a railway track where passengers board trains.
words.example: Our train leaves from platform four.
words.collocations: wait on the platform for your train, railway platform

words.definitionEn: An arrangement guaranteeing a particular seat.
words.example: A seat reservation is recommended on busy services.

words.definitionEn: To leave one train and board another during a journey.
words.example: We need to change trains at the next station.

words.definitionEn: A train that reaches the destination without requiring passengers to change trains.
words.translationUz: poyezd almashtirmasdan manzilga olib boradigan poyezd
words.example: A direct train avoids the need for a connection.

words.definitionEn: A place where trains stop for people to get on or off.
words.example: We met at the train station before our journey.
words.collocations: railway station, arrive at the train station

words.definitionEn: Enter a car as a driver or passenger.
words.example: It is safer to get in a car from the pavement when traffic is busy.

words.definitionEn: Leave a car after riding in it.
words.example: Wait until it stops before you get out of a car.

words.definitionEn: A large passenger ship on a route / a vessel carrying people or vehicles across water / a sailing or motor boat used for pleasure.
words.example: A ferry carried us to the island.

words.definitionEn: A journey across a stretch of water.
words.example: The crossing took two hours.

words.definitionEn: A holiday travelling by ship, usually visiting several places.
words.example: The cruise stopped at three ports.
words.collocations: go on a cruise, take a cruise

words.definitionEn: A bed on a train or ship; also a place where a ship can be moored.
words.translationUz: poyezd yoki kemadagi yotoq joyi / kemaning bandargohdagi turish joyi
words.example: We reserved a berth in a shared cabin.

words.term: a shared / single / double / deluxe cabin
words.definitionEn: A ship’s room shared with others / for one person / for two / with upgraded comfort.
words.translationUz: umumiy / bir kishilik / ikki kishilik / yuqori qulaylikdagi kayuta
words.example: We chose a double cabin for the crossing.

words.definitionEn: A higher level of a ship.
words.example: We watched the coastline from the upper deck.

words.definitionEn: A ship’s control area / a passage used to board or leave a vessel.
words.translationUz: kemani boshqarish ko‘prigi / kemaga chiqish yoki tushish uchun trap
words.example: Passengers walked up the gangway.

words.definitionEn: The person in command of a ship or aircraft / a worker looking after passengers.
words.translationUz: kema kapitani / yo‘lovchilarga xizmat ko‘rsatuvchi xodim
words.example: The steward showed us to our cabin.

words.definitionEn: A harbour or town where ships arrive and depart.
words.example: The ship returned to port before sunset.

words.definitionEn: Get onto a plane, train, ship or similar vehicle as a passenger.
words.example: Passengers began to board the ferry at nine.
words.collocations: board a plane, board a train, board a ship

words.definitionEn: Get off a plane or ship, or leave another passenger vehicle at the end of a journey.
words.example: Please wait for the crew to say it is safe to disembark.
words.collocations: disembark from a ship, get off a train

words.definitionEn: A large passenger ship designed for holiday voyages.
words.example: The cruise ship stopped at several ports along the coast.

words.definitionEn: A vessel designed to carry goods rather than passengers.
words.example: The cargo ship brought containers from overseas.
words.collocations: container ship, load a cargo ship

words.definitionEn: Transport goods in a ship, aircraft or other vehicle.
words.example: These ships carry cargo between the main ports.

words.definitionEn: A ship or large boat.
words.example: The rescue vessel returned to port before dark.

words.definitionEn: A structure built out from the shore into water, often for boats to stop at or people to walk along.
words.translationUz: qirg‘oqdan suvga cho‘zilgan inshoot, qayiq to‘xtash joyi
words.example: The ferry leaves from the pier at noon.
words.collocations: ferry pier, walk along the pier

words.definitionEn: A flying machine / a very large passenger jet / an aircraft lifted by rotating blades.
words.translationUz: havo kemasi / yirik reaktiv yo‘lovchi samolyoti / vertolyot
words.example: A helicopter flew over the harbour.

words.definitionEn: The pilot’s control compartment / the structures that provide lift on an aircraft.
words.example: Passengers cannot normally enter the cockpit.

words.definitionEn: A passage between rows of seats / a seat beside that passage.
words.example: I prefer an aisle seat on long flights.

words.definitionEn: Airport employees working on the ground rather than as flight crew.
words.example: Ground staff helped passengers find the new gate.

words.definitionEn: The staff looking after passenger safety and comfort aboard an aircraft.
words.example: The cabin crew demonstrated the safety equipment.

words.definitionEn: A person who directs aircraft movements to maintain safe separation.
words.example: The air traffic controller guided the plane towards the runway.

words.definitionEn: A shop selling goods exempt from certain taxes under applicable rules.
words.example: We visited the duty-free shop before departure.

words.definitionEn: An airport passenger building / the strip used by aircraft for take-off and landing.
words.example: The bus took us to the terminal.

words.definitionEn: To pass the checks used to protect travellers and transport facilities.
words.example: Leave enough time to go through security.

words.definitionEn: An official checking goods entering or leaving a country.
words.example: A customs officer asked about the contents of the bag.

words.definitionEn: An aircraft powered by one or more jet engines.
words.example: The company hired a private jet for the trip.

words.definitionEn: Register for a flight before boarding, online or at the airport.
words.example: You can check in for a flight online before you leave for the airport.
words.collocations: check in online, check in at the airport

words.definitionEn: A paper or digital document that gives a passenger permission to board a flight.
words.example: Show your boarding pass before entering the aircraft.
words.collocations: scan a boarding pass, mobile boarding pass

words.definitionEn: The airport exit through which passengers go to board a particular flight.
words.example: The boarding gate changed just before departure.

words.definitionEn: Bags, cases and other containers that passengers take with them when they travel.
words.example: We left our luggage at the hotel before going sightseeing.

words.definitionEn: Bags that passengers are allowed to take into the aircraft cabin.
words.translationUz: qo‘l yuki, samolyot saloniga olib kiriladigan yuk
words.example: Keep your passport in your carry-on luggage.

words.definitionEn: Bags that passengers hand over before boarding to travel in the aircraft hold.
words.translationUz: ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazilib, samolyot yuk bo‘limiga topshiriladigan yuk
words.example: Our checked luggage arrived on a later flight.

words.definitionEn: The area at an airport where passengers collect luggage after a flight.
words.translationUz: aeroportda topshirilgan yukni olib ketish hududi
words.example: Follow the signs to the baggage reclaim area.

words.definitionEn: A moving belt on which checked luggage is delivered to passengers at an airport.
words.translationUz: aeroportda yuk aylanib chiqadigan konveyer lentasi
words.example: Our suitcase was already on the baggage carousel.

words.definitionEn: To be held up for a long time beyond the expected schedule.
words.example: Our flight may be severely delayed because of fog.

words.definitionEn: A flight that will not operate as planned.
words.example: Passengers on the cancelled flight needed alternative travel.

words.definitionEn: To be unable to leave an airport or continue the journey.
words.example: Nobody wants to be stuck at an airport overnight.

words.definitionEn: To provide or arrange accommodation for someone.
words.example: Can you put someone up for a night if their flight is cancelled?

words.definitionEn: To wait for a place on a service if a seat becomes available.
words.translationUz: bo‘sh joy chiqishini kutish ro‘yxatida bo‘lmoq
words.example: I will be on standby for the morning flight.

words.definitionEn: To obtain a place to sit or travel on a service.
words.example: We managed to get a seat on a later train.

words.definitionEn: At the scheduled or agreed time.
words.example: The train arrived on time.

words.definitionEn: A flight leaving near the beginning of the day.
words.example: We booked an early-morning flight.

words.definitionEn: Irregular air movements that can make an aircraft shake.
words.example: The pilot warned us about turbulence.

words.definitionEn: An aircraft landing that is not smooth.
words.example: We had a bumpy landing in strong winds.

words.definitionEn: To feel ill because of movement during air travel; that illness.
words.translationUz: samolyotda ko‘ngli aynimoq / parvozda ko‘ngil aynishi
words.example: Some passengers get airsick on small aircraft.

words.definitionEn: Tiredness and disturbed sleep caused by travelling quickly across time zones.
words.translationUz: vaqt mintaqalari o‘zgarganidan uyqu rejimining buzilishi
words.example: It took several days to recover from jet lag.

words.definitionEn: A person working as part of a vessel’s or aircraft’s crew while aboard it.
words.example: A crew member on board helped secure the equipment.

words.definitionEn: To proceed without significant difficulty or interruption.
words.example: We expect the transfer arrangements to run smoothly.

words.definitionEn: Water with large waves / relatively still water.
words.example: The ferry moved slowly through a rough sea.

words.definitionEn: To feel ill because of a boat’s movement; that illness.
words.example: Some passengers get seasick when the sea is rough.

words.definitionEn: Arrive in time to take the flight you booked.
words.example: Leave early enough to catch your flight.
words.collocations: catch a flight, catch the last flight

words.definitionEn: Fail to get on the flight you booked, especially because you arrive too late.
words.example: You may miss your flight if your train is late.
words.collocations: miss a flight, miss a connecting flight

words.definitionEn: An area where people can stay in tents or caravans.
words.translationUz: chodir tikib tunash uchun ajratilgan joy
words.example: The campsite has showers and drinking water.

words.definitionEn: To put up a tent ready for use.
words.example: We learnt to pitch a tent before the trip.

words.definitionEn: A vehicle or trailer equipped as living accommodation for travel.
words.example: They stayed in a caravan near the coast.

words.definitionEn: Holiday accommodation where guests prepare their own meals.
words.translationUz: ovqatni o‘zi tayyorlash mumkin bo‘lgan kvartira
words.example: We rented a self-catering apartment.

words.definitionEn: A relatively small establishment offering accommodation, often with breakfast.
words.example: The guest house was run by a local family.

words.definitionEn: Budget accommodation often offering shared rooms and facilities.
words.translationUz: yoshlar uchun arzon umumiy turar joy, yoshlar hosteli
words.example: We met other travellers at the youth hostel.

words.definitionEn: Beds arranged one above the other.
words.example: The hostel room had two sets of bunk beds.

words.definitionEn: A small holiday house or cabin, often associated with mountain resorts.
words.translationUz: tog‘dagi yog‘och dam olish uyi, shale
words.example: We stayed in a chalet near the ski slopes.

words.definitionEn: A small establishment offering food, drink and accommodation.
words.example: The inn overlooks the village square.

words.definitionEn: Accommodation with breakfast and one main meal / accommodation with three main meals a day.
words.translationUz: nonushta va yana bir mahal ovqat / uch mahal ovqat kiritilgan turar joy tarifi
words.example: We chose half board so we could eat lunch elsewhere.
words.collocations: full board, full board accommodation, full board rate

words.definitionEn: Reserve a place to stay, usually before travelling.
words.example: We need to book accommodation near the old town.

words.definitionEn: An accommodation rate that does not include meals.
words.translationUz: faqat xona, ovqat narxga kiritilmagan tarif
words.example: We booked room only because we wanted to have breakfast at local cafés.

words.definitionEn: Accommodation with breakfast included in the price.
words.translationUz: tunash joyi va nonushta narxga kiritilgan tarif
words.example: We booked bed and breakfast at a small guest house.

words.definitionEn: Travelling by staying at other people's homes, usually for free.
words.translationUz: safarda mahalliy kishilarning uyida odatda bepul tunash
words.example: Couchsurfing helped us meet local people during our trip.

words.definitionEn: A low-cost place to stay that often has shared rooms and facilities.
words.example: We booked a hostel near the old town.
words.collocations: stay in a hostel, hostel dormitory

words.definitionEn: A large room where several people sleep.
words.translationUz: bir necha kishi uchun umumiy yotoq xona
words.example: Our hostel had a six-bed dormitory.

words.definitionEn: A hotel designed mainly for people travelling by car, usually with convenient parking.
words.translationUz: avtomobilda sayohat qiluvchilar uchun yo‘l bo‘yidagi mehmonxona
words.example: We stayed at a motel just off the motorway.

words.definitionEn: A business that provides rooms for paying guests, often with meals or other services.
words.example: Our hotel was a short walk from the station.

words.definitionEn: A large detached house, especially one used for holidays.
words.example: They rented a villa with a pool for the summer.

words.definitionEn: A small house, usually in the countryside.
words.example: We rented a cottage in the mountains.

words.definitionEn: A holiday involving exciting or challenging outdoor activities.
words.example: An adventure holiday may involve rafting and trekking.

words.definitionEn: To visit interesting or famous places.
words.example: We plan to go sightseeing in the old town.

words.definitionEn: To make a short visit during a longer journey.
words.example: We want to stop off at a coastal village on the way home.

words.definitionEn: A holiday destination with accommodation and leisure facilities beside the sea.
words.example: The beach resort was busy in summer.

words.definitionEn: A holiday travelling between several places rather than staying in one.
words.translationUz: bir necha manzilni aylanib chiqish safari
words.example: We planned a touring holiday by car.

words.definitionEn: To live without the usual comforts for a time.
words.example: You need to be willing to rough it when camping there.

words.definitionEn: To continue travelling rather than remain in one place.
words.translationUz: doim yo‘lda bo‘lmoq, joydan joyga ko‘chib yurmoq
words.example: We like to keep on the move during our holidays.

words.definitionEn: To move or spend time without a fixed plan or much effort.
words.example: On the cruise, we could simply drift along and relax.

words.definitionEn: To sleep outdoors with the night sky above you.
words.example: We hoped to sleep under the stars in dry weather.

words.definitionEn: To be in a remote, relatively undeveloped natural area.
words.translationUz: odam kam boradigan yovvoyi tabiat qo‘ynida bo‘lmoq
words.example: We will be out in the wilds for three days, away from mobile coverage.

words.definitionEn: To make your own decisions rather than follow someone else’s instructions.
words.example: A self-catering holiday lets you be your own boss.

words.definitionEn: To spend time relaxing with little activity.
words.example: They decided to lounge around beside the pool.

words.term: spend a fortune on entrance fees
words.definitionEn: To pay a very large amount to enter attractions.
words.translationUz: kirish chiptalariga juda ko‘p pul sarflamoq
words.example: It is easy to spend a fortune on entrance fees.

words.definitionEn: An experience from which you gain useful knowledge or understanding.
words.example: The guided visit was a real learning experience.

words.definitionEn: A comfortable, warm and welcoming feeling in a place.
words.example: The inn has a cosy atmosphere.

words.definitionEn: An exceptionally special holiday that someone expects always to remember.
words.translationUz: umrda bir marta nasib etadigan unutilmas ta’til
words.example: The cruise was a holiday of a lifetime.

words.definitionEn: An organised visit to a place or a journey around several places, sometimes with a guide.
words.example: We went on a guided tour of the old town.
words.collocations: go on a tour, guided tour

words.definitionEn: To go somewhere with fewer people.
words.example: We walked inland to escape the crowds.

words.definitionEn: To visit places that few tourists normally go to.
words.example: We wanted to get off the beaten track.

words.definitionEn: To spend time in a natural environment away from urban routines.
words.translationUz: tabiat qo‘ynida vaqt o‘tkazib, tabiatga yaqinlashmoq
words.example: Camping helped us get back to nature.

words.definitionEn: The part of the economy providing services for visitors.
words.example: The tourism sector supports many local jobs.

words.definitionEn: A traveller who judges quality carefully and knows what they want.
words.translationUz: tanlashda did va talabchanlik bilan yondashadigan sayohatchi
words.example: The small hotel appeals to the discerning traveller.

words.definitionEn: Of a place, to have an attractive or impressive feature.
words.example: Several coastal towns boast attractive waterfronts.

words.definitionEn: Very large crowds of visitors, often expressed negatively.
words.example: Hordes of tourists gathered at the viewpoint.

words.definitionEn: A large and rich variety or amount of wild animal life.
words.example: The reserve supports a wealth of wildlife.

words.definitionEn: The plants and animals of a place.
words.example: Visitors should avoid disturbing the flora and fauna.

words.definitionEn: An area protected for natural or cultural importance / an area protected especially for wildlife and habitats.
words.example: The national park includes a small nature reserve.

words.definitionEn: Extensive areas of land.
words.example: Large tracts of land remain forested.

words.definitionEn: Rainforest described as largely untouched by human activity.
words.example: The guide described the remote area as virgin rainforest.

words.term: seek something out of the ordinary
words.definitionEn: To look for something unusual or different.
words.example: These travellers seek something out of the ordinary.

words.definitionEn: To relax / recover your energy after a demanding period.
words.translationUz: hordiq chiqarmoq / dam olib, kuchini tiklamoq
words.example: A quiet break can help you unwind after a busy month.

words.definitionEn: Wild land with bushes, trees or grass, especially in Australia or Africa.
words.translationUz: odam kam yashaydigan butazorli yovvoyi hudud
words.example: The tour took us into the bush.

words.definitionEn: A vehicle with power available to all four wheels.
words.example: The guide drove a 4x4 along the rough track.

words.definitionEn: A holiday house beside a river, lake or the sea.
words.example: We rented a waterfront villa.

words.definitionEn: Of accommodation, to have space for as many as six people to sleep.
words.translationUz: olti kishigacha tunashi uchun joyi bo‘lmoq
words.example: The apartment can sleep up to six.

words.definitionEn: Extremely beautiful natural surroundings or setting.
words.example: The route passes through stunning scenery.

words.definitionEn: Prices advertised as at least as good as competing offers.
words.example: The brochure promises unbeatable prices.

words.definitionEn: Creating a strong feeling of wonder or admiration.
words.example: The mountains were awe-inspiring.

words.definitionEn: Widely known and admired for something.
words.example: The region is renowned for its hiking trails.

words.definitionEn: A leisurely countryside walk / a more demanding walk / a long, often difficult journey on foot.
words.translationUz: rohat uchun piyoda sayr / uzoq piyoda yurish / uzoq va mashaqqatli piyoda safar
words.example: We chose a short ramble rather than a demanding trek.

words.definitionEn: Described as having no equal in quality or ability.
words.example: The hotel advertises unrivalled views.

words.definitionEn: Natural surroundings with attractive views.
words.example: The railway passes through scenic landscapes.

words.definitionEn: A warm-region destination presented as exceptionally beautiful and pleasant.
words.example: The island is promoted as a tropical paradise.

words.definitionEn: Travel to natural areas intended to support conservation and benefit local communities.
words.translationUz: ekoturizm, tabiatga ehtiyotkorlik bilan sayohat qilish
words.example: Good ecotourism supports local guides and protects habitats.

words.definitionEn: A town, region or country people travel to for a visit.
words.example: The island is a popular tourist destination.

words.definitionEn: A particular place, landmark or activity that attracts visitors.
words.translationUz: sayyohlarni jalb qiladigan diqqatga sazovor joy yoki faoliyat
words.example: The old fortress is the city's main tourist attraction.

words.definitionEn: A forest that has experienced very little human disturbance.
words.translationUz: deyarli inson ta’siriga uchramagan tabiiy o‘rmon
words.example: The trail passes through a pristine forest.

words.definitionEn: A large enclosed park where visitors can see wild animals moving in open areas, often from a vehicle.
words.translationUz: yovvoyi hayvonlarni odatda avtomobildan kuzatish mumkin bo‘lgan safari bog‘i
words.example: We saw giraffes at the safari park.

words.definitionEn: Take a trip to observe wild animals in their natural environment.
words.translationUz: yovvoyi hayvonlarni tabiiy muhitida kuzatish safariga chiqmoq
words.example: We hope to go on a safari to see elephants in the wild.

words.definitionEn: To enjoy something slowly and fully.
words.example: Take time to savour the local food.

words.definitionEn: The central or most characteristic area of a region or country.
words.translationUz: mamlakat yoki mintaqaning asosiy, markaziy qismi
words.example: The journey continues into the country’s agricultural heartland.

words.definitionEn: A place far from towns or other centres of activity.
words.example: The lodge is in a remote location.

words.definitionEn: A road with many bends.
words.example: A winding road led to the campsite.

words.definitionEn: The rural land around a particular place.
words.example: We explored the surrounding countryside.

words.definitionEn: A drive that causes intense fear.
words.example: The narrow mountain road made it a terrifying drive.

words.definitionEn: A holiday that remains clear in your memory.
words.example: The walking tour made it a memorable holiday.

words.definitionEn: A town that is extremely interesting.
words.example: The guide introduced us to a fascinating town.

words.definitionEn: Buildings that attract admiration through their appearance, scale or quality.
words.example: The square is surrounded by impressive buildings.

words.definitionEn: A very pleasant and charming hotel.
words.example: We found a delightful hotel beside the river.

words.definitionEn: A setting that makes access or activities difficult.
words.example: The hotel’s inconvenient location meant a long bus ride each day.

words.definitionEn: Food of unusually high quality.
words.example: The village restaurant serves exceptional food.

words.definitionEn: Views or natural surroundings of remarkable beauty.
words.translationUz: nafasni rostlashni unuttiradigan darajada go‘zal manzaralar
words.example: The summit offers breathtaking views.

words.definitionEn: Permission to enter or use something restricted to a selected group.
words.translationUz: faqat muayyan kishilarga beriladigan kirish huquqi
words.example: Guests have exclusive access to the private garden.

words.definitionEn: An experience that makes you feel excited and full of energy.
words.translationUz: kuchli hayajon va zavq uyg‘otadigan taassurot
words.example: The mountain walk was an exhilarating experience.

words.definitionEn: A place perceived as unusual and exciting compared with what someone knows.
words.example: The brochure promises an exotic location.

words.definitionEn: A setting associated with attractiveness, excitement and luxury.
words.example: The reception was held in glamorous surroundings.

words.definitionEn: Accommodation providing a high level of comfort.
words.example: The resort offers luxurious accommodation.

words.definitionEn: Streets or villages that are especially attractive to look at.
words.example: We wandered through picturesque streets.

words.definitionEn: Natural attractiveness or woodland largely unaffected by damaging development.
words.translationUz: buzilmagan tabiiy joziba / o‘z holicha saqlangan o‘rmonzor
words.example: The island retains much of its unspoilt charm.

words.definitionEn: A special chance unlike others or not readily repeated.
words.example: The visit offered a unique opportunity to meet local artists.

words.definitionEn: To let other road users go first, stopping if necessary.
words.example: At the junction, drivers must give way to traffic on the main road.

words.definitionEn: Priority to proceed before other road users in a particular situation.
words.example: The signs show who has the right of way.

words.definitionEn: A designated place where people cross a road.
words.example: We crossed at a pedestrian crossing.

words.term: sound your horn / beep your horn
words.definitionEn: To make a vehicle’s warning device produce a sound.
words.example: You may need to sound your horn to warn another driver of danger.
words.collocations: sound your horn, beep your horn, honk, beeping, honking

words.definitionEn: To drive past a traffic signal when it shows red.
words.example: Drivers who jump a red light put pedestrians at risk.
words.collocations: run a red light, jump a red light

words.definitionEn: Driving with serious disregard for safety.
words.example: The campaign warns about reckless driving.

words.definitionEn: Driving while unlawfully affected by alcohol / drugs.
words.translationUz: alkogol / narkotik modda ta’sirida transport boshqarish
words.example: The police campaign targets drink-driving and drug-driving.
words.collocations: driving under the influence, DUI, drink-driving, drug-driving

words.definitionEn: A test of breath used to estimate alcohol levels.
words.example: The officer asked the driver to take a breathalyser test.

words.definitionEn: A collision in which a driver leaves without stopping to fulfil their responsibilities.
words.translationUz: to‘qnashuvdan keyin haydovchi voqea joyidan qochib ketgan yo‘l-transport hodisasi
words.example: Witnesses reported a hit-and-run accident.

words.definitionEn: A legal prohibition on driving for a period.
words.example: The offence resulted in a driving ban.

words.definitionEn: Points recorded for driving offences in some licensing systems.
words.example: Repeated offences can lead to penalty points.

words.definitionEn: A financial penalty issued at the place where an offence is detected.
words.example: The driver received an on-the-spot fine.

words.definitionEn: Gases and particles released through a vehicle’s exhaust.
words.example: Cleaner engines can reduce exhaust emissions.

words.definitionEn: In a condition suitable for safe use on the road.
words.example: A mechanic checked that the car was roadworthy.

words.definitionEn: The patterned surface of a tyre / a tyre whose tread has worn away.
words.example: The mechanic replaced a bald tyre with almost no tyre tread.

words.definitionEn: Rules that drivers, cyclists and pedestrians must follow on the road.
words.example: All road users must follow the traffic rules.
words.collocations: traffic regulations, obey the traffic rules

words.definitionEn: Red, amber and green signals that control traffic where roads meet or at crossings.
words.translationUz: svetofor, yo‘l harakatini tartibga soluvchi rangli chiroqlar
words.example: Turn right at the traffic lights.

words.definitionEn: A sign beside or above a road giving drivers or other road users information, instructions or warnings.
words.example: A road sign warned drivers about the sharp bend.

words.definitionEn: A sign, often on a post, that points towards a place or shows how far away it is.
words.example: We followed the signpost to the railway station.

words.definitionEn: Police officers who enforce road traffic rules and help manage traffic.
words.translationUz: yo‘l-patrul politsiyasi, yo‘l harakati xavfsizligi xodimlari
words.example: The traffic police closed the road after the collision.

words.definitionEn: Money that a person is officially required to pay for breaking a rule or law.
words.example: The fine for parking here is fifty dollars.
words.collocations: pay a fine, a heavy fine

words.definitionEn: Be officially ordered to pay money for breaking a law or rule.
words.example: You may get a fine if you park in a bus lane.

words.definitionEn: Order someone to pay money as punishment for breaking a rule or law.
words.example: The authorities can fine someone for parking in a bus lane.
words.collocations: impose a fine on someone, fine someone for speeding

words.definitionEn: Officially require a person to pay money as a penalty.
words.example: A court can impose a fine on someone who breaks the law.
words.collocations: impose a fine for a violation

words.definitionEn: A financial penalty for parking in a prohibited place or breaking a parking rule.
words.example: She paid a parking fine for leaving her car in front of the gate.

words.definitionEn: A notice telling a driver that they have broken a parking rule and usually owe a fine.
words.translationUz: to‘xtash qoidasi buzilgani uchun jarima xabarnomasi
words.example: I got a parking ticket for leaving my car in a loading zone.

words.definitionEn: Hit a person with a moving vehicle and go over them.
words.translationUz: birovni transport vositasi bilan bosib ketmoq
words.example: A driver who ignores a crossing can run someone over.

words.definitionEn: Officially cancel a driver's licence.
words.example: The authorities can revoke a driving licence after repeated serious offences.

words.definitionEn: Do something that is prohibited by road traffic rules.
words.example: Drivers who break traffic rules may receive a fine.
words.collocations: violate traffic regulations, breach traffic regulations

words.definitionEn: Give someone a fine immediately at the place where the offence occurred.
words.example: An officer can issue an on-the-spot fine for illegal parking.

words.definitionEn: A period when many people travel to or from work and traffic is heavy.
words.example: Avoid the motorway during rush hour.

words.definitionEn: A long line of slow-moving or stationary traffic.
words.example: The accident caused a tailback.

words.definitionEn: Heavy traffic that slows movement / a fee for driving in a designated congested area.
words.translationUz: yo‘l tirbandligi / tirband hududga kirish uchun to‘lov
words.example: A congestion charge aims to reduce traffic congestion.
words.collocations: traffic jam, heavy congestion, pay a congestion charge

words.definitionEn: To pay a charge to use a road, bridge or similar route.
words.translationUz: pulli yo‘l yoki ko‘prik uchun haq to‘lamoq
words.example: Drivers must pay a toll to cross the bridge.

words.definitionEn: A collision involving several vehicles.
words.translationUz: zanjirli avariya, bir nechta avtomobil to‘qnashuvi
words.example: Fog contributed to a motorway pile-up.

words.definitionEn: To be directed along a different route.
words.example: Traffic will be diverted around the closed road.

words.definitionEn: Interruption to the normal movement of vehicles.
words.example: Snow caused traffic disruption.

words.definitionEn: An area where illegally parked vehicles may be removed.
words.translationUz: qoidabuzar avtomobil evakuator bilan olib ketiladigan hudud
words.example: The car was left in a tow-away zone.

words.definitionEn: Of a vehicle, to have a wheel immobilised with a locking device.
words.example: An illegally parked car may be clamped.

words.definitionEn: Angry or violent behaviour by road users towards other road users.
words.example: The argument escalated into road rage.

words.definitionEn: To slide out of control while turning a corner.
words.example: The car began to skid on a bend.
words.collocations: skid, skid on ice, skid on a bend

words.definitionEn: An accident in which vehicles strike each other front first.
words.example: The road was closed after a head-on collision.

words.definitionEn: A place where roads meet.
words.example: Turn left at the next junction.

words.definitionEn: To be unable to move normally because traffic is very heavy.
words.example: Take the tram if you do not want to be stuck in traffic.
words.collocations: be stuck in traffic, be stuck in a traffic jam

words.definitionEn: Congestion so severe that vehicles cannot move through a road network.
words.translationUz: harakatni deyarli to‘xtatib qo‘yadigan kuchli tirbandlik
words.example: The blocked junction caused gridlock.

words.definitionEn: To move to the side of the road and stop.
words.example: The driver will pull over as soon as it is safe.

words.definitionEn: A small collision causing limited damage.
words.example: The car had a minor bump in the car park.

words.definitionEn: To stop working suddenly, especially of an engine; informal.
words.example: An old engine can conk out without warning.

words.definitionEn: Someone who gives unwanted advice or criticism to the person driving.
words.translationUz: haydovchiga so‘ralmagan maslahat berib turadigan yo‘lovchi
words.example: He can be a back-seat driver when we travel together.

words.definitionEn: Interrupt or slow the normal movement of vehicles on a road.
words.example: Roadworks can disrupt the traffic flow for hours.
words.collocations: disrupt traffic, interrupt the flow of traffic

words.definitionEn: Remove a car by pulling it away with another vehicle.
words.example: The city may tow away a car if it is blocking an entrance.

words.definitionEn: Drive past another car, for example by going ahead of it when it is travelling in the same direction.
words.translationUz: boshqa avtomobil yonidan o‘tmoq, uni quvib o‘tmoq
words.example: Wait until the road ahead is clear before you pass another car.

words.definitionEn: A marked or recognised strip of road for a single line of vehicles.
words.example: The driver moved into the left lane before turning.
words.collocations: bus lane, change lanes, inside lane

words.definitionEn: A bridge carrying one road over another road or a railway.
words.example: The new flyover carries traffic over the busy junction.

words.definitionEn: A road or path that passes beneath another road or a railway.
words.example: Pedestrians can use the underpass to reach the station.

words.definitionEn: A circular junction around which vehicles travel before leaving at an exit.
words.example: Take the second exit at the roundabout.

words.definitionEn: Reduce overcrowding and delays on busy roads or transport routes.
words.example: More frequent buses could ease congestion near the city centre.

words.definitionEn: Public travel services that people can depend on to run regularly.
words.example: Reliable public transport matters as much as low fares.

words.definitionEn: The time a person spends travelling between home and work or study.
words.translationUz: uy bilan ish yoki o‘qish o‘rtasidagi qatnov vaqti
words.example: The new station cut her commute time by twenty minutes.

words.definitionEn: Start using public transport in place of another mode of travel.
words.example: People are more likely to shift to public transport when transfers are convenient.

words.definitionEn: Streets arranged so that walking is safe, comfortable and convenient.
words.example: Pedestrian-friendly streets help local shops attract regular customers.

words.definitionEn: Actions designed to reduce crashes and injuries on roads.
words.example: Road safety measures near schools include lower speed limits.

words.definitionEn: Transport that covers the final part of a journey to the destination.
words.translationUz: manzilgacha so‘nggi masofani qamrab oluvchi qatnov
words.example: A short shuttle provides a last-mile connection from the station to the campus.

words.definitionEn: The amount of travel people want or need to make.
words.example: Travel demand is highest on weekdays during the morning peak.

words.definitionEn: Keep facilities such as roads, tracks or bridges in usable condition.
words.example: Cities need a regular budget to maintain infrastructure.

words.definitionEn: Rules limiting the pollution a vehicle or other source can release.
words.example: Stricter emission standards can improve air quality over time.

words.definitionEn: How easily travellers can pay the cost of a journey.
words.example: Fare affordability is particularly important for people on low incomes.

words.definitionEn: Increase the number and coverage of connected routes for cyclists.
words.example: The council plans to expand cycling networks beyond the city centre.

words.definitionEn: The amount of rain falling in a particular place over a period.
words.example: The station records monthly rainfall.

words.definitionEn: The part of the year when a region typically receives most of its rain.
words.example: The roads are harder to use during the wet season.

words.definitionEn: The part of the year when a region normally receives little rain.
words.example: Water use rises during the dry season.

words.definitionEn: Very dry, with little rainfall.
words.example: The plants can survive in an arid climate.

words.definitionEn: Likely to experience or suffer from a particular problem.
words.example: The low-lying district is prone to flooding.

words.definitionEn: A prolonged shortage of water caused by unusually low precipitation or related conditions.
words.example: The region experienced a serious drought.

words.definitionEn: A cold, mostly treeless biome where low-growing plants predominate.
words.translationUz: tundra, sovuq va asosan daraxtsiz tabiiy mintaqa
words.example: Few trees can grow on the tundra.

words.definitionEn: The plants growing in a particular place.
words.example: Dense vegetation covers the slope.

words.definitionEn: A forest dominated by cone-bearing trees such as pines or firs.
words.example: The trail crosses a coniferous forest.

words.definitionEn: Keeping leaves or needles throughout the year.
words.example: An evergreen tree gives the garden colour in winter.

words.definitionEn: Losing leaves seasonally.
words.example: A deciduous tree sheds its leaves during part of the year.

words.definitionEn: The broad belt of mainly coniferous forest in northern regions.
words.translationUz: tayga, shimolning keng ignabargli o‘rmon mintaqasi
words.example: The taiga stretches across large parts of Canada and Eurasia.

words.definitionEn: A large expanse of North American grassland.
words.translationUz: preriya, Shimoliy Amerikadagi keng o‘tloq tekisligi
words.example: The prairie stretches towards the horizon.

words.definitionEn: An extensive, usually dry grassland, especially in Eurasia.
words.example: The road crosses open steppe.

words.definitionEn: The broad grassland plains of parts of southern South America.
words.translationUz: pampa, Janubiy Amerikadagi keng o‘tloq tekisliklari
words.example: The documentary follows wildlife on the pampas.

words.definitionEn: A forest in a region with a generally moderate climate and seasonal variation.
words.example: The reserve contains an old temperate forest.

words.definitionEn: Forest in which the trees grow very close together.
words.example: The trail runs through dense forest.

words.definitionEn: A forest dominated by trees that lose their leaves seasonally.
words.example: We walked through a deciduous forest.

words.definitionEn: A forest found in a region with very high rainfall.
words.example: The research team surveyed the rainforest.

words.definitionEn: A forest containing a mixture of tree types, often conifers and broad-leaved trees.
words.example: The path passes through a mixed forest.

words.definitionEn: A field used for growing rice, often deliberately flooded.
words.example: Water covered the paddy field.

words.definitionEn: Plants grown for harvest, or the produce gathered at one time.
words.example: Rice is the main crop in the valley.

words.definitionEn: Gather a mature crop.
words.example: Farmers harvest the grain when it is ready.

words.definitionEn: Grasses grown for edible grain, or their grains collectively.
words.example: The farm grows cereals such as wheat and barley.

words.definitionEn: Look after farm animals.
words.example: The family hires workers to tend livestock.

words.definitionEn: A large area managed for growing a particular crop or trees.
words.translationUz: plantatsiya, bir turdagi ekin yoki daraxt yetishtiriladigan katta maydon
words.example: The road passes through a tea plantation.

words.definitionEn: The sector that makes goods from materials or components.
words.example: The city has a large manufacturing industry.

words.definitionEn: Businesses that produce chemicals and related products.
words.example: The report examines waste from the chemical industry.

words.definitionEn: In a leading position in a field or activity.
words.example: The lab is at the forefront of materials research.

words.definitionEn: Produce electrical energy.
words.example: The installation uses wind to generate electricity.

words.definitionEn: A field planted with wheat.
words.example: The farmer inspected the wheat field.

words.definitionEn: An area with underground oil deposits that can be extracted.
words.example: Work at the oil field began many years ago.

words.definitionEn: A region in which magnetic forces act.
words.example: A compass aligns with Earth’s magnetic field.

words.definitionEn: Businesses that develop or manufacture medicines.
words.example: The report examines research in the pharmaceutical industry.

words.definitionEn: Businesses that produce fabrics and other textile products.
words.example: The region was once a centre of the textile industry.

words.definitionEn: Businesses involved in making or processing steel.
words.example: The steel industry supplies material for construction.

words.definitionEn: A large area where coffee plants are cultivated.
words.example: The farm includes a coffee plantation.

words.definitionEn: A large area planted with trees grown for natural rubber.
words.example: Workers collected latex on the rubber plantation.

words.definitionEn: A large area planted with tea bushes.
words.example: The hillsides are covered by a tea plantation.

words.definitionEn: A large area where a crop such as sugar cane is grown for sugar.
words.example: The archive records the history of a sugar plantation.

words.definitionEn: A broad label often used for a country with a relatively advanced economy and infrastructure.
words.example: The author explains what counts as a developed nation in the study.

words.definitionEn: A broad label applied to countries in some economic development classifications.
words.example: The report explains how it classifies a developing country.

words.definitionEn: A nation or state that governs itself and is not subject to another state’s authority.
words.example: The treaty recognises it as a sovereign nation.

words.definitionEn: Have a particular person or group among one’s ancestors.
words.example: She is believed to be descended from early settlers.

words.definitionEn: Relating to peoples with historical ties to a place predating colonisation or later settlement; more generally, native to a place.
words.example: The exhibition was developed with Indigenous communities.

words.definitionEn: A person in an earlier generation of one’s family.
words.example: An ancestor of hers lived in the village.

words.definitionEn: A person related by descent to someone from an earlier generation.
words.example: He is a descendant of the original owner.

words.definitionEn: A person who moves from one place to another to live, temporarily or permanently.
words.translationUz: ko‘chib yuruvchi yoki boshqa joyga ko‘chgan kishi, migrant
words.example: The survey interviewed a migrant who had moved within the country.

words.definitionEn: A person who leaves a country to live elsewhere, viewed from the country of departure.
words.translationUz: o‘z mamlakatidan ko‘chib ketgan kishi, emigrant
words.example: The letter describes life as an emigrant.

words.definitionEn: A person who comes into another country to live there, viewed from the destination.
words.translationUz: boshqa mamlakatdan ko‘chib kelgan kishi, immigrant
words.example: The book follows an immigrant settling in a new city.

words.definitionEn: Make one’s home in a place.
words.example: The family decided to settle near the coast.

words.definitionEn: A state that controls or has controlled colonies.
words.example: The archive contains maps drawn by the former colonial power.

words.definitionEn: A country that governs itself rather than being controlled by another country.
words.example: It became an independent nation after the agreement.
